title: Losing the Bride and the Soldiers Too
synopsis: Sun Quan and Zhou Yu attempt to lure Liu Bei to his death, but things do not go as planned.

fullText.simplified:
赔了夫人又折兵

    在三国故事里，荆州是每个人都想得到的地方。有一段时间，江东得到了荆州，但因为一些原因，带军住在荆州的人是刘备，不是江东的人。江东想让刘备把荆州还回来，但刘备一直没有还。
    江东的周瑜觉得应该想个办法让刘备来江东，然后让他还荆州。如果不还，就杀了他。
    周瑜想了个办法。他对主公孙权说：“您可以和刘备说，希望他和您妹妹结婚，请他来江东见一面。”
    孙权明白周瑜的意思。他觉得这个办法不错，马上写信给刘备说了结婚的事。
    刘备收到信，问军师诸葛亮：“我能去江东吗？”
    诸葛亮说：“结婚是大事，孙权让妹妹和您结婚，您不能不去。”
    于是刘备就去了江东。他按照诸葛亮的建议，一到江东就去见了江东的一些名人，把他要和孙权妹妹结婚的事告诉给了他们。很快，几乎每个江东人都知道刘备要和孙权的妹妹结婚了。
    孙权的妈妈也听说了这件事。她生气地对孙权说：“我知道你和周瑜想做什么，但现在江东人都知道你妹妹要和刘备结婚了，如果最后他们没有结婚，你知道这对一个女子来说有多坏吗？以后你妹妹还能结婚吗？谁愿意和她结婚呢？她以后一个人要怎么过？”
    妈妈越说越生气，但事情已经发生了，没有办法了。她决定去见见刘备，如果刘备不错，就让女儿和他结婚。她去见了刘备，然后放心了，她对刘备很满意。
    孙权和周瑜很生气，真想马上杀了刘备，但妈妈不会同意，而且江东人也不会同意。刘备是收到江东的信来江东结婚的，江东怎么能杀他呢？
    就这样，刘备和孙权的妹妹孙尚香真的结婚了。让人没想到的是，虽然婚前没有见过面，但婚后的两人，你喜欢我，我喜欢你，过得很幸福。
    刘备在江东住了很长时间。后来他收到诸葛亮的信，要他回荆州。刘备担心孙权和周瑜不让他离开，孙尚香说：“我带你走，我跟你去荆州。”
    孙尚香带着刘备离开，孙权的人要拦。孙尚香说：“你们不认识我吗？谁敢拦我？”大家不敢拦孙尚香，只能看着她和刘备离开。
    周瑜知道了，马上带人来拦，但他来晚了，刘备和孙尚香已经坐上诸葛亮的船离开了。周瑜在河边还遇到了诸葛亮的人，他的人打不过诸葛亮的人，有些人被杀了。
    这就是有名的“赔了夫人又折兵”的故事。现在“赔了夫人又折兵”已经是一个成语了，意思是想占便宜，但没占到便宜，还有了其他方面的损失。比如，网上购物时遇到满300元减50元的活动，有人为了减50元，买了很多不需要的东西。结果发现不但买回来的东西没用，而且还多花了钱，这时候就可以说一句：“赔了夫人又折兵，以后再也不乱买东西了。”
fullText.traditional:
賠了夫人又折兵

    在三國故事裡，荊州是每個人都想得到的地方。有一段時間，江東得到了荊州，但因為一些原因，帶軍住在荊州的人是劉備，不是江東的人。江東想讓劉備把荊州還回來，但劉備一直沒有還。
    江東的周瑜覺得應該想個辦法讓劉備來江東，然後讓他還荊州。如果不還，就殺了他。
    周瑜想了個辦法。他對主公孫權說：“您可以和劉備說，希望他和您妹妹結婚，請他來江東見一面。”
    孫權明白周瑜的意思。他覺得這個辦法不錯，馬上寫信給劉備說了結婚的事。
    劉備收到信，問軍師諸葛亮：“我能去江東嗎？”
    諸葛亮說：“結婚是大事，孫權讓妹妹和您結婚，您不能不去。”
    於是劉備就去了江東。他按照諸葛亮的建議，一到江東就去見了江東的一些名人，把他要和孫權妹妹結婚的事告訴給了他們。很快，幾乎每個江東人都知道劉備要和孫權的妹妹結婚了。
    孫權的媽媽也聽說了這件事。她生氣地對孫權說：“我知道你和周瑜想做什麼，但現在江東人都知道你妹妹要和劉備結婚了，如果最後他們沒有結婚，你知道這對一個女子來說有多壞嗎？以後你妹妹還能結婚嗎？誰願意和她結婚呢？她以後一個人要怎麼過？”
    媽媽越說越生氣，但事情已經發生了，沒有辦法了。她決定去見見劉備，如果劉備不錯，就讓女兒和他結婚。她去見了劉備，然後放心了，她對劉備很滿意。
    孫權和周瑜很生氣，真想馬上殺了劉備，但媽媽不會同意，而且江東人也不會同意。劉備是收到江東的信來江東結婚的，江東怎麼能殺他呢？
    就這樣，劉備和孫權的妹妹孫尚香真的結婚了。讓人沒想到的是，雖然婚前沒有見過面，但婚後的兩人，你喜歡我，我喜歡你，過得很幸福。
    劉備在江東住了很長時間。後來他收到諸葛亮的信，要他回荊州。劉備擔心孫權和周瑜不讓他離開，孫尚香說：“我帶你走，我跟你去荊州。”
    孫尚香帶著劉備離開，孫權的人要攔。孫尚香說：“你們不認識我嗎？誰敢攔我？”大家不敢攔孫尚香，只能看著她和劉備離開。
    周瑜知道了，馬上帶人來攔，但他來晚了，劉備和孫尚香已經坐上諸葛亮的船離開了。周瑜在河邊還遇到了諸葛亮的人，他的人打不過諸葛亮的人，有些人被殺了。
    這就是有名的“賠了夫人又折兵”的故事。現在“賠了夫人又折兵”已經是一個成語了，意思是想佔便宜，但沒占到便宜，還有了其他方面的損失。比如，網上購物時遇到滿300元減50元的活動，有人為了減50元，買了很多不需要的東西。結果發現不但買回來的東西沒用，而且還多花了錢，這時候就可以說一句：“賠了夫人又折兵，以後再也不亂買東西了。”

.. after getting married they grew fond of each other and lived happily together.

sentences.simplified: 刘备在江东住了很长时间。
sentences.traditional: 劉備在江東住了很長時間。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi zài jiāng dōng zhù le hěn cháng shí jiān

sentences.simplified: 后来他收到诸葛亮的信，要他回荆州。
sentences.traditional: 後來他收到諸葛亮的信，要他回荊州。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā shōu dào zhū gě liàng de xìn yào tā huí jīng zhōu
sentences.english: Liu Bei stayed in Jiangdong for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 刘备担心孙权和周瑜不让他离开，
sentences.traditional: 劉備擔心孫權和周瑜不讓他離開，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi dān xīn sūn quán hé zhōu yú bú ràng tā lí kāi
sentences.english: Later, he received a letter from Zhuge Liang, asking him to return to Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 孙尚香说：“我带你走，我跟你去荆州。”
sentences.traditional: 孫尚香說：“我帶你走，我跟你去荊州。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn shàng xiāng shuō wǒ dài nǐ zǒu wǒ gēn nǐ qù jīng zhōu
sentences.english: Liu Bei was worried that Sun Quan and Zhou Yu would not let him leave.
Sun Shangxiang said, “I’ll take you with me, and I will go with you to Jingzhou.”

sentences.simplified: 孙尚香带着刘备离开，孙权的人要拦。
sentences.traditional: 孫尚香帶著劉備離開，孫權的人要攔。
sentences.pinyin: sūn shàng xiāng dài zhe liú bèi lí kāi sūn quán de rén yào lán

sentences.simplified: 孙尚香说：“你们不认识我吗？谁敢拦我？”
sentences.traditional: 孫尚香說：“你們不認識我嗎？誰敢攔我？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn shàng xiāng shuō nǐ men bú rèn shi wǒ ma shéi gǎn lán wǒ
sentences.english: Sun Shangxiang led Liu Bei away, but Sun Quan’s men tried to stop them.

sentences.simplified: 大家不敢拦孙尚香，只能看着她和刘备离开。
sentences.traditional: 大家不敢攔孫尚香，只能看著她和劉備離開。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā bù gǎn lán sūn shàng xiāng zhǐ néng kàn zhe tā hé liú bèi lí kāi
sentences.english: Sun Shangxiang said, “Don’t you recognize me? Who dares to stop me?”
As nobody dared to stop her, they could only watch her leave with Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 周瑜知道了，马上带人来拦，但他来晚了，
sentences.traditional: 周瑜知道了，馬上帶人來攔，但他來晚了，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu yú zhī dào le mǎ shàng dài rén lái lán dàn tā lái wǎn le

sentences.simplified: 刘备和孙尚香已经坐上诸葛亮的船离开了。
sentences.traditional: 劉備和孫尚香已經坐上諸葛亮的船離開了。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi hé sūn shàng xiāng yǐ jīng zuò shàng zhū gě liàng de chuán lí kāi le
sentences.english: Zhou Yu found out and immediately led his men to intercept them, but he was too late.

sentences.simplified: 周瑜在河边还遇到了诸葛亮的人，他的人打不过诸葛亮的人，有些人被杀了。
sentences.traditional: 周瑜在河邊還遇到了諸葛亮的人，他的人打不過諸葛亮的人，有些人被殺了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu yú zài hé biān hái yù dào le zhū gě liàng de rén tā de rén dǎ bú guò zhū gě liàng de rén yǒu xiē rén bèi shā le
sentences.english: Liu Bei and Sun Shangxiang had already boarded Zhuge Liang’s boat and left.
Zhou Yu also encountered Zhuge Liang’s men by the river. His men were no match for Zhuge Liang’s men, and some were killed.

sentences.simplified: 这就是有名的“赔了夫人又折兵”的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這就是有名的“賠了夫人又折兵”的故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì yǒu míng de péi le fū rén yòu zhé bīng de gù shi

sentences.simplified: 现在“赔了夫人又折兵”已经是一个成语了，
sentences.traditional: 現在“賠了夫人又折兵”已經是一個成語了，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài péi le fū rén yòu zhé bīng yǐ jīng shì yí ge chéng yǔ le
sentences.english: This is the famous tale of “losing the bride and the soldiers too”.

sentences.simplified: 意思是想占便宜，但没占到便宜，还有了其他方面的损失。
sentences.traditional: 意思是想佔便宜，但沒占到便宜，還有了其他方面的損失。
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì xiǎng zhàn pián yi dàn méi zhàn dào pián yi hái yǒu le qí tā fāng miàn de sǔn shī
sentences.english: Now, “losing the bride and the soldiers too” has become an idiom.

sentences.simplified: 比如，网上购物时遇到满300元减50元的活动，
sentences.traditional: 比如，網上購物時遇到滿300元減50元的活動，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú wǎng shang gòu wù shí yù dào mǎn 2 yuán jiǎn 2 yuán de huó dòng
sentences.english: The meaning is wanting to take advantage but failing to gain anything and even suffering other losses as a result.

sentences.simplified: 有人为了减50元，买了很多不需要的东西。
sentences.traditional: 有人為了減50元，買了很多不需要的東西。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén wèi le jiǎn 2 yuán mǎi le hěn duō bù xū yào de dōng xi
sentences.english: For example, say you are shopping online and encounter a promotion of 50 yuan off when you spend 300 yuan.

sentences.simplified: 结果发现不但买回来的东西没用，而且还多花了钱，
sentences.traditional: 結果發現不但買回來的東西沒用，而且還多花了錢，
sentences.pinyin: jié guǒ fā xiàn bú dàn mǎi huí lai de dōng xi méi yòng ér qiě hái duō huā le qián
sentences.english: Some people buy a lot of unnecessary items just to get the 50 yuan discount.

sentences.simplified: 这时候就可以说一句：“赔了夫人又折兵，以后再也不乱买东西了。”
sentences.traditional: 這時候就可以說一句：“賠了夫人又折兵，以後再也不亂買東西了。”
sentences.pinyin: zhèi shí hou jiù kě yǐ shuō yí jù péi le fū rén yòu zhé bīng yǐ hòu zài yě bú luàn mǎi dōng xi le
sentences.english: The result is that not only have they bought things that are useless, but they also spent money unnecessarily.

sentence_translations: Losing the Bride and the Soldiers Too
In the stories of the Three Kingdoms, Jingzhou was the place everyone wanted to seize.
For a period of time, Jiangdong was in control of Jingzhou.
However, for various reasons, the person leading the army in Jingzhou was Liu Bei and not someone from Jiangdong.
Jiangdong wanted Liu Bei to hand back Jingzhou, but Liu Bei still hadn’t returned it.
Zhou Yu of Jiangdong thought they should come up with a way to bring Liu Bei to Jiangdong, and then make him hand back Jingzhou.
If he didn’t give it back, he would be killed.
Zhou Yu came up with an idea.
He said to his lord, Sun Quan, ..
.. “You could tell Liu Bei that you wish for him to marry your younger sister, and invite him to come to Jiangdong for a meeting.”
Sun Quan understood what Zhou Yu meant.
He thought that this was a good plan and immediately wrote a letter to Liu Bei about the marriage.
When Liu Bei received the letter, he asked his military advisor Zhuge Liang, “Should I go to Jiangdong?”
Zhuge Liang said, “Marriage is a significant matter.
Sun Quan is offering you his younger sister’s hand in marriage, so you cannot refuse to go.”
So, Liu Bei went to Jiangdong.
On Zhuge Liang’s advice, as soon as he arrived in Jiangdong, he went to meet some of the notable figures there, ..
.. informing them that he was to marry Sun Quan’s younger sister.
Soon, almost everyone in Jiangdong knew that Liu Bei was going to marry Sun Quan’s younger sister.
Sun Quan’s mother also heard about this matter.
She angrily said to Sun Quan, ..
.. “I know what you and Zhou Yu want to do, but now the people of Jiangdong all know that your younger sister is going to marry Liu Bei.
If they don’t end up getting married, do you know just how bad that is for a woman?
Will your younger sister still be able to get married in the future? Who would be willing to marry her?
How will she live on her own in the future?”
The more his mother spoke, the angrier she became, but the matter had already happened, and there was nothing she could do.
She decided to meet Liu Bei, and if Liu Bei was not bad, she would let her daughter marry him.
She went to meet Liu Bei and felt relieved. She was very satisfied with him.
Sun Quan and Zhou Yu were very angry and truly wanted to kill Liu Bei on the spot.
However, Sun Quan’s mother would not agree, and the people of Jiangdong would not agree either.
Liu Bei had received a letter from Jiangdong to come there to get married. How could Jiangdong then kill him?
So just like that, Liu Bei and Sun Quan’s younger sister, Sun Shangxiang, really did get married.
What no one expected was that, although they had never met before the marriage, ..
.. after getting married they grew fond of each other and lived happily together.
Liu Bei stayed in Jiangdong for a long time.
Later, he received a letter from Zhuge Liang, asking him to return to Jingzhou.
Liu Bei was worried that Sun Quan and Zhou Yu would not let him leave.
Sun Shangxiang said, “I’ll take you with me, and I will go with you to Jingzhou.”
Sun Shangxiang led Liu Bei away, but Sun Quan’s men tried to stop them.
Sun Shangxiang said, “Don’t you recognize me? Who dares to stop me?”
As nobody dared to stop her, they could only watch her leave with Liu Bei.
Zhou Yu found out and immediately led his men to intercept them, but he was too late.
Liu Bei and Sun Shangxiang had already boarded Zhuge Liang’s boat and left.
Zhou Yu also encountered Zhuge Liang’s men by the river. His men were no match for Zhuge Liang’s men, and some were killed.
This is the famous tale of “losing the bride and the soldiers too”.
Now, “losing the bride and the soldiers too” has become an idiom.
The meaning is wanting to take advantage but failing to gain anything and even suffering other losses as a result.
For example, say you are shopping online and encounter a promotion of 50 yuan off when you spend 300 yuan.
Some people buy a lot of unnecessary items just to get the 50 yuan discount.
The result is that not only have they bought things that are useless, but they also spent money unnecessarily.
At this point, you could say: “I lost the bride and the soldiers too— I will never shop so recklessly again.”
